text.title: 意见桌旁的两把椅子
text.situation:
靠远墙的两把椅子面对一张小桌。诺拉请一位常来的访客和一名志愿者讨论时间表，两人带来不同视角。访客提出把所有课程都搬到网上的建议，志愿者则认为有些活动需要当面参与。乔记下访客“没人会介意变化”的断言，再问有什么证据。谈到无法使用电脑的人时，大家意识到讨论需要谨慎。客观意味着准确记录不同说法，而不是假装它们一致。诺拉希望围绕维修的公共讨论能包括这些实际问题。文章变得有用，并不要求谁在交谈中获胜。

访客：我的建议是把所有课程搬到网上。
志愿者：在我看来，这会让一些人无法参加。
乔：能核查有多少人需要线下选择吗？

paragraphs.en: By the far wall, two chairs faced a small table. Nora had invited a regular visitor and a volunteer to discuss the timetable. Each brought a different perspective. The visitor put forward a proposition to move every class online; the volunteer’s contention was that some activities depended on meeting in person. Jo wrote down the visitor’s assertion that no one would mind the change, then asked what evidence supported it. The sensitivity of the discussion became clear when the visitor mentioned people who could not use a computer. Objectivity meant recording the different accounts accurately, not pretending they were identical. Nora wanted the public discourse around the repairs to include these practical concerns. Neither guest had to win the conversation for the article to become more useful.

paragraphs.en:
Visitor: My proposition is to move all the classes online.
Volunteer: From my perspective, that would exclude some people.
Jo: Could we check how many people need an in-person option?

S16.N08.P01.function: Two chairs at the opinion table
acceptableAnswers: 志愿者提供了不同视角。 访客提出把课程搬到网上。 乔质疑了没人会介意的断言。

S16.N08.P02.function: Two chairs at the opinion table
S16.N08.P02.cue: 说明哪些主张需要依据。
acceptableAnswers: 志愿者的论点是有些课程需要场地。 诺拉努力保持客观。

S16.N08.P03.function: Two chairs at the opinion table
S16.N08.P03.cue: 说说如何报道这场需要谨慎对待的讨论。
acceptableAnswers: 乔意识到讨论的敏感性质。 文章参与了关于维修的公共讨论。

S16.N08.T01.function: Two chairs at the opinion table
